hostname rt-y01
!
crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-PROP
 encryption aes-cbc-256
 integrity sha256
 group 14
 prf sha256
!
crypto ikev2 policy IKEV2-POL
 proposal IKEV2-PROP
!
crypto ikev2 keyring IKEV2-KEYS
 peer Tunnel1
  address 203.0.113.20
  pre-shared-key local dummy-psk-site-y01
  pre-shared-key remote dummy-psk-site-y02
!
crypto ikev2 profile IKEV2-Tunnel1
 match identity remote key-id sample-site-b
 identity local key-id sample-site-a
 authentication remote pre-share
 authentication local pre-share
 keyring local IKEV2-KEYS
 lifetime 86400
 dpd 30 5 periodic
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-Tunnel1 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 set transform-set TS-Tunnel1
 set pfs group14
 set security-association lifetime seconds 28800
 set ikev2-profile IKEV2-Tunnel1
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.252
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel1
 description sample vpn
 ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet0/1
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.20
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-Tunnel1
 no shutdown
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.10 1
ip route 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1 1
!
end
